title: 🎉 Celebrations (праздники) & Countable/Uncountable nouns
description: Учимся говорить о праздниках, фестивалях и исчисляемых/неисчисляемых существительных. Мемы, TikTok и весёлые традиции! 🎊

days.title: Day 1: Festive Activities
days.description: Что мы делаем на праздниках? Учим слова и фразы

grammar.title: Festive Activities — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
📘 **Что мы делаем на праздниках?**:

🎆 **set off fireworks** — запускать фейерверки
🎪 **have street parades** — устраивать уличные парады
🎭 **dress up** — наряжаться
🎁 **exchange gifts** — обмениваться подарками
🍽️ **have family dinners** — устраивать семейные ужины
🎶 **sing songs** — петь песни
💃 **dance** — танцевать
🍰 **eat special food** — есть особую еду

📌 **Пример**:
✅ On Victory Day, we have street parades.
✅ We set off fireworks on New Year's Eve.

📌 **Пример**:
'On Victory Day, we have street parades. We also set off fireworks. It's so cool! 🎆'

vocabulary.example: We set off fireworks on New Year.
vocabulary.context_example: Мы запускаем фейерверки в Новый год.

vocabulary.example: There is a big parade on Victory Day.
vocabulary.context_example: В День Победы проходит большой парад.

vocabulary.example: We have a big dinner on New Year's Eve.
vocabulary.context_example: У нас большой ужин в канун Нового года.

exercises.question: What do we set off on New Year? 🎆
exercises.explanation: We set off fireworks on New Year! 🎆

exercises.question: On Victory Day, we have street ___ . 🎪
We exchange gifts on New Year.
exercises.explanation: Yes! We exchange gifts on New Year! 🎁

exercises.explanation: This is correct! A big dinner on New Year! 🍽️

days.title: Day 2: Harvest Festivals Around the World
days.description: Учимся говорить о праздниках урожая в разных странах

grammar.title: Harvest Festivals — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
📘 **Праздники урожая в мире**:

🇺🇸🇨🇦 **Thanksgiving** — День благодарения (США, Канада)
🇮🇳 **Holi** — Холи (Индия, праздник урожая)
🇵🇭 **Banana Festival** — Фестиваль бананов (Филиппины)
🇰🇷 **Chuseok** — Чусок (Корея, праздник урожая)

📌 **Пример**:
✅ Thanksgiving is in November in the USA.
✅ Holi is a five-day festival in India.

📌 **Пример**:
'Thanksgiving is a festival. People eat turkey and pumpkin pie. 🦃🥧'

vocabulary.example: There are many varieties of bananas.
It's a tradition to wear costumes.

exercises.question: What do people eat on Thanksgiving? 🦃
Holi is a ___ festival in India. 🇮🇳
exercises.explanation: Holi is a harvest festival in India! 🇮🇳

exercises.question: Thanksgiving is celebrated in July.
exercises.explanation: Thanksgiving is in November, not July! 🦃

exercises.question: Chuseok is a Korean festival.
exercises.explanation: Chuseok is a Korean harvest festival! 🇰🇷

days.title: Day 3: Grammar — Countable and Uncountable Nouns

grammar.title: Countable and Uncountable Nouns
grammar.rule:
📘 **Исчисляемые и неисчисляемые существительные**:

📌 **Countable nouns** (можно посчитать):
✅ apple → two apples
✅ banana → three bananas
✅ egg → four eggs
✅ costume → five costumes

📌 **Uncountable nouns** (нельзя посчитать):
✅ milk (молоко) ❌ a milk
✅ rice (рис) ❌ a rice
✅ water (вода) ❌ a water
✅ bread (хлеб) ❌ a bread

📌 **Слова-помощники**:
• a/an + countable (singular)
• some + uncountable / countable (plural)
• any + negative/question

📌 **Пример**:
I want an apple. (исчисляемое, один)
I want some milk. (неисчисляемое)
I don't have any oranges. (исчисляемое, вопрос/отрицание)
There is some rice. (неисчисляемое)

vocabulary.example: There is some rice on the table.

exercises.question: Which word is countable? 🔢
exercises.explanation: Apple — можно посчитать: one apple, two apples! 🍎

exercises.question: 'A milk' is correct.
exercises.explanation: Milk is uncountable! 'Some milk', not 'a milk'! 🥛

exercises.question: What do people eat at Thanksgiving? 🦃
exercises.explanation: People eat turkey, sweet potatoes and pumpkin pie at Thanksgiving! 🦃🥧
exercises.readingText:
🌟 HARVEST FESTIVALS AROUND THE WORLD 🌟

People all over the world celebrate harvest festivals. Let's learn about some of them!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🇺🇸🇨🇦 THANKSGIVING — USA AND CANADA

Thanksgiving is a big festival in the USA and Canada. It celebrates the harvest. Canadians celebrate it in October, and Americans celebrate it in November. On this day, families have big dinners. They eat turkey, sweet potatoes and cranberry sauce. For dessert, there is pumpkin pie. Some cities have parades. It's a very popular holiday! 🦃

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🇮🇳 HOLI — INDIA

Holi is a Hindu harvest festival. It's in late February or early March. The festival lasts five days! People dress up in colourful clothes and light fires. Farmers decorate their cows with flowers and let them run free in the streets. It's a very colourful and fun festival! 🌸

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🇵🇭 BANANA FESTIVAL — THE PHILIPPINES

In the Philippines, people celebrate the Banana Festival in late March or early April. This is a harvest festival about different varieties of bananas. During the festival, children dress up in banana costumes and dance in the streets. There is also a cooking competition! Cooks use only bananas to make their dishes. 🍌

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🇰🇷 CHUSEOK — KOREA

Chuseok is the Korean harvest moon festival. It's an important holiday in Korea. The festival lasts for three days, usually between August and October. People make sweet rice cakes with fresh fruit. It's a time for families to come together. 🇰🇷

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💬 WHAT FESTIVAL DO YOU CELEBRATE? 👇

exercises.question: Chuseok is a Korean festival.
exercises.explanation: Yes! Chuseok is the Korean harvest moon festival! 🇰🇷

exercises.question: People eat bananas at Thanksgiving.
exercises.explanation: People eat turkey and pumpkin pie at Thanksgiving, not bananas! 🦃

exercises.question: At the Banana Festival, cooks use only ___ to make dishes. 🍌
exercises.explanation: Cooks use only bananas to make dishes at the Banana Festival! 🍌

grammar.title: Countable/Uncountable — практика
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как использовать исчисляемые и неисчисляемые существительные**:

📌 **Countable + plural**:
✅ I have some apples.
✅ I don't have any oranges.

📌 **Uncountable**:
✅ I have some milk.
✅ I don't have any water.

📌 **Вопросы**:
❓ How many apples? (countable)
❓ How much milk? (uncountable)

📌 **Пример**:
❓ How many bananas have you got?
✅ I have two bananas.
❓ How much rice have you got?
✅ I have a lot of rice.

exercises.question: 'How many water' is correct.
exercises.explanation: Water is uncountable → how much water! 💧

exercises.question: I don't have ___ bananas. (some / any)
exercises.explanation: Negative → any! I don't have any bananas! 🍌

grammar.title: Повторение: праздники и существительные
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ What is the name of the festival? (Название праздника)
2️⃣ When is it? (Когда он отмечается?)
3️⃣ What do people do? (Что люди делают?)
4️⃣ What do they eat? (Что они едят?)
5️⃣ Why do you like it? (Почему тебе нравится?)

📌 **Пример**:
My favourite festival is New Year. It's on 31st December. We set off fireworks, have a big dinner and exchange gifts. We eat salad and cake. I like it because it's fun and I get presents! 🎄🎁
